d:
Will the government reduce LTCG tax to revive the Indian stock market? Reuters has reported that SEBI has proposed LTCG relief for foreign investors and certain mutual fund investors. In this episode of Kharcha Pani, we explain LTCG tax, FII selling, stock market returns, SEBI’s proposal, Nirmala Sitharaman’s remarks, SBI Ecowrap suggestions, and the key question — can the government afford to give up such huge tax revenue?
Production: Shruti
Video Editor: Ved
